| TunerStudio label | Setting | Units | Range | Help (as TunerStudio shows it) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| SD Card Logging | `isSdCardEnabled` | choice |  |  |
| Always start in Logging mode | `alwaysWriteSdCard` | choice |  | Write SD card log even when powered by USB |
| SD logger mode | `sdLoggerMode` | choice |  | 'Trigger' mode will write a high speed log of trigger events (warning: uses lots of space!). 'Full MLG' mode will write a standard MLG of sensors, engine function, etc. similar to the one captured in TunerStudio. 'DTC Freeze Frame' will write one frame MLG log and short CSV trigger log on every DTC |
| MLG logger rate | `sdCardLogFrequency` | hz | 1 … 250 | Rate the ECU will log to the SD card, in hz (log lines per second). |
| Conditional logging | `sdCardConditionalLogging` | choice |  | Only write the SD log while trigger conditions are met (start/stop). Off = always log, the current behavior. |
| Start RPM | `sdLogStartRpm` | rpm | 0 … 30000 | Start logging at/above this RPM |
| Stop RPM (hysteresis, < start) | `sdLogStopRpm` | rpm | 0 … 30000 | Stop logging below this RPM. Set below 'start' for hysteresis |
| Stop delay | `sdLogStopDelay` | sec | 0 … 255 | Keep logging this many seconds after RPM drops below the stop threshold |
| Also require TPS above (0 = ignore) | `sdLogMinTps` | % | 0 … 100 | Also require TPS at/above this to start logging (0 = ignore) |
| Also require MAP above (0 = ignore) | `sdLogMinMap` | kPa | 0 … 1000 | Also require MAP at/above this to start logging (0 = ignore) |
| Also require speed above (0 = ignore) | `sdLogMinVss` | kph | 0 … 255 | Also require vehicle speed at/above this to start logging (0 = ignore) |
| Toggle button pin (overrides RPM) | `sdLogTriggerPin` | choice |  | Optional toggle button to start/stop logging (press on, press off) https://rusefi.com/docs/pinouts/proteus/?highlight=class~switch_inputs |
| Toggle button mode | `sdLogTriggerPinMode` | choice |  |  |
